login.title: Log in to {brand}
login.lead: Enter your phone number to manage your bookings.
login.incomplete: The number is incomplete — it needs {digits} digits.
login.notMobile: Codes go to mobile numbers only. Enter a number starting with {starts}.
login.tooManyCodes: Too many codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.codeHint: It checks itself after the 4th digit.
login.codeExpired: The old code no longer works.
login.wrongCode: Wrong code. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
login.locked: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

identity.title: Is this you, {name}?
identity.lead: This number’s account hasn’t been used for 6 months. Numbers sometimes pass to someone new, so we ask before you go in.
identity.ownsWorkspace: This account owns a business on {brand}, so it can’t start afresh here. Contact {brand} to sort out the number.

login.demoNote: This is a demo of {brand}: the sign-in code shows here instead of an SMS. Use a made-up number, and don’t type in real people’s names or numbers.

profile.title: Profile and settings
profile.personalLead: Businesses see this name on your bookings.
profile.changeLead: We’ll send an SMS code to the new number.

newPhone.label: New phone number
newPhone.hint: {digits} digits. The SMS code comes to this number.

profile.accountLead: Log out of this device or delete your account entirely.
profile.deleteLead: Your upcoming bookings are cancelled, and your account, favourites and reviews are deleted. This can’t be undone.
profile.deleteBody: Your upcoming bookings will be cancelled and the businesses told. Your account, favourites and reviews will be deleted; businesses keep their own records of your visits. This can’t be undone.

home.lead: Search, business pages and booking come with the next parts of the site.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The address may have changed, or the page was removed.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

business.approximate: Approximate area: the exact address comes with a confirmed booking.
business.exampleInstant: This isn't a real business. It's here so you can try {brand}: bookings are confirmed at once, and nobody waits for you.
business.exampleManual: This isn't a real business. It's here so you can try {brand}.

preview.pending: Your page is in review — only you and your team can see it. After the review it opens in search and at your link.
preview.rejectedNoReason: Your page wasn't approved. Fix it in {brand} Business and send it again.
preview.hidden: {brand} has hidden your page: {reason} Clients can't find or book you.
preview.hiddenNoReason: {brand} has hidden your page. Clients can't find or book you.

favourite.failed: Couldn't change your favourites. Try again.

share.label: Share
share.failed: Couldn't share the link. Copy it from the address bar.

restricted.title: You can book this business by phone
restricted.lead: The business asked to arrange bookings with you by phone.

paused.title: This place isn't taking online bookings right now

notOpen.title: This page hasn't opened yet
notOpen.lead: The business is new on {brand} and its page is being checked. It opens here once it's approved.

staff.title: Choose a specialist
staff.lead: Choose «Any specialist» and we'll show the earliest free time.
staff.label: Specialist
staff.cantAll: Doesn't do all the selected services
staff.noOneDoesAll: No one specialist does all the selected services: a free specialist is chosen for each.

time.title: Choose a time
time.empty: No free time on this day
time.emptyLead: Choose another day or go to the next free day.

confirm.title: Confirm your booking
confirm.lead: Sending the booking comes with the next part of the site.
